title: Title — Navigating the KG-RAG Cosmos
description: Title slide introducing all 10 papers and the research journey from differentiable retrieval to RMF-RAG.

title: D-RAG — Research Question & Methodology
description: EMNLP 2025. How Gumbel-Softmax makes fact selection differentiable so the generator can teach the retriever.

title: D-RAG — Results & Key Findings
description: WebQSP 89.1% Hits@1, MetaQA-3hop 97.7%. End-to-end training yields biggest gains on hardest multi-hop questions.

title: CogGRAG — Research Question & Methodology
description: AAAI 2026. Mind-map decomposition + dual-process verification inspired by human cognition System 1/System 2.

title: CogGRAG — Results & Key Findings
description: Hallucination reduced from 55.2% to 25.0%. Explicit verification and honest abstention are the most powerful anti-hallucination mechanisms.

title: Goal-Oriented KG — Research Question & Methodology
description: Information 2026. SPARQL on procedural goal trees for regulatory accounting knowledge.

title: Goal-Oriented KG — Results & Key Findings
description: F1 0.83 vs ChatGPT-4o 0.15. Symbolic SPARQL beats GPT-4o by 5.5x on specialized procedural knowledge.

title: M³KG-RAG — Research Question & Methodology
description: CVPR 2026. Multi-hop multimodal KG with modality-matched FAISS retrieval and GRASP grounding verification.

title: M³KG-RAG — Results & Key Findings
description: VALOR benchmark 44.67 vs prior best 35.44. Grounding verification (GRASP) cuts hallucinated audio/visual claims.

title: KG-RAG (Wang et al.) — Research Question & Methodology
description: Scientific Reports 2025. Dual-channel text+GNN retrieval with BiGRU path attention for medical QA.

title: KG-RAG (Wang et al.) — Results & Key Findings
description: PubMedQA 81.3%, NQ +7.5% EM. Dynamic fusion of text and KG paths at each decoding step.

title: GraphFlow — Research Question & Methodology
description: NeurIPS 2025. Transition-based Euclidean flow matching with reward factorization for multi-step KG retrieval.

title: GraphFlow — Results & Key Findings
description: STaRK benchmark +10% over GPT-4o. Nearest prior work to RMF-RAG — same insight, Euclidean geometry.

title: SG-RAG — Research Question & Methodology
description: ICNLSP 2024. Cypher query generation for Neo4j subgraph retrieval on MetaQA movie knowledge.

title: SG-RAG — Results & Key Findings
description: MetaQA 90/73/58% at 1/2/3-hop vs 42/27/19% for vanilla RAG. The 3-hop drop is what RMF-RAG targets.

title: HyKGE — Research Question & Methodology
description: ACL 2025. Hypothesis generation before retrieval bridges vocabulary gap between patient language and clinical KGs. Hy = Hypothesis, NOT hyperbolic.

title: HyKGE — Results & Key Findings
description: MMCU-Medical +14.3% EM, hallucination -57%, context relevance +84%. Hypothesis generation is the most effective vocabulary-gap bridge.

title: KRAGEN — Research Question & Methodology
description: Bioinformatics 2024. Graph-of-Thoughts decomposition with vertex-level retrieval for multi-gene biomedical QA.

title: KRAGEN — Results & Key Findings
description: Retrieving at each reasoning step beats single-pass retrieval. Graph structure guides what to look up next.

title: KG²RAG — Research Question & Methodology
description: NAACL 2025. BFS KG expansion + Maximum Spanning Tree + DFS narrative chunks for coherent multi-document retrieval.

title: KG²RAG — Results & Key Findings
description: HotpotQA F1 0.663, uses 19% fewer chunks. KG-connected chunks produce better answers than semantically similar ones.

title: What All 10 Papers Share — The Gap
description: Every neural embedding-based RAG system encodes KG structure in flat Euclidean space, distorting hierarchical multi-hop structure. This shared gap motivates RMF-RAG.

title: What is RMF-RAG?
description: Riemannian Manifold Flow RAG — three core innovations: Poincaré ball entity embedding, geodesic distance retrieval, D-RAG training loop preserved.

title: How RMF-RAG Works — The Mechanism
description: Poincaré disk visualization, geodesic distance formula, and 5-step pipeline replacing Euclidean embeddings with Poincaré ball via geoopt.

title: The Path Forward — HyperKG-RAG
description: 10-week undergraduate experiment plan: datasets (WebQSP, CWQ, MetaQA-3hop), baselines (D-RAG ablation, CogGRAG, SG-RAG), tool (geoopt), target venue (ACL/EMNLP Findings).
